verdict.rationale: TruffleHog documents the `--fail` flag which exits non-zero on findings (verified via hands-on probe exiting 183 on findings and 0 when clean), enabling CI pipelines to fail builds on new secrets, and docs explicitly cover pre-commit/pre-receive hook integration plus filtering via --results=verified,unknown for scoping. Missing for 10: no first-party CI-specific example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow YAML) or documented diff-only 'new findings on PR' mode distinguishing from full-history scans.
